verdict.rationale: Gmail docs mention Gemini-based 'Organize' features (adding labels, deleting emails on request) and traditional rule-based filters that auto-apply labels, but these are either manual on-demand assistant actions or static filter rules, not an autonomous AI system that continuously triages/categorizes the inbox and surfaces what needs attention. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic AI-driven inbox categorization/prioritization, a mechanism to audit or review AI triage decisions, and explicit steering controls (e.g., rules for what AI should flag) beyond ad-hoc filter setup.
